7 ways to be unrecognisable
in 90 days
Walk 10,000 steps a day. Every day, no excuses, rain or not. In 90 days you'll be leaner, sleep better and think more clearly. It's the most underrated habit there is, and it's completely free.
Fix your posture. Shoulders back, chin level, phone at eye height. Do a few minutes of mobility work every morning. Ninety days of standing tall changes how people see you before you speak.
Cut sugar from your drinks. No soda, no sweet coffee, no energy drinks. Water, black coffee, tea. Most guys lose weight faster from this one switch than from anything they try at the gym.
Read ten pages a night. In 90 days that's around five books. You'll talk differently, think differently and fall asleep easier than you ever did scrolling until 1am with the lights off.
Upgrade three basics. One pair of jeans that fits, one jacket, one pair of clean shoes. You don't need a new wardrobe. You need three things that fit well and that you wear all the time.
Try this for 30 days, then keep going: five minutes a day of history, art or science. By day 90 you'll be the one explaining things at dinner instead of nodding along.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days, then keep going: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. By day 90 you'll be the one explaining things at dinner, not just nodding along.

slides.texte_overlay: Say yes to one new thing a week. A class, a run club, a dinner with people you don't know yet. Thirteen new experiences in 90 days. Your stories change, and so does the way you carry yourself.
